'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Aaron Nelson DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
